description: Thick black smoke and chemical odor emitting from illegal industrial incinerator near agricultural fields.
voice_transcript: Large black plume rising fast, burning plastics aroma.

analysis.pollution_source: Unpermitted industrial chimney discharge & boiler combustion
recommended_verification: Dispatch municipal environmental inspector to industrial quadrant
Verify factory continuous emission monitoring (CEMS) log
analysis.explanation: Citizen sighting confirms unpermitted industrial chimney discharge & boiler combustion. Current wind conditions (4.0 km/h from 95°) indicate limited atmospheric dispersion, amplifying localized risk on top of ambient PM2.5 levels (252.0 µg/m³). Immediate human-supervised verification recommended.
